policy_parameters_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the active content safety policy parameters

time_window_hash.description: SHA256 hash of (start, end) timestamps of the attested window

total_samples.description: Total number of moderated samples in the window

min_rejection_count.description: Minimum rejection count the agent claims to have met

actual_rejection_count.description: Actual count of samples rejected as unsafe (kept private)

TrustedSetupMethod: Solo Developer MVP Setup - For production use only with proper ceremony

MVP_Limitations: Policy hash + time window hash verification is simplified
Integer-only arithmetic; samples & rejection counts are u64
Security_Considerations: Trusted setup performed by single developer for MVP
Production deployment requires multi-party computation ceremony
